translations.web: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.
translations.bsb: He is torn from the shelter of his tent and is marched off to the king of terrors.
translations.kjv: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
translations.asv: He shall be rooted out of his tent where he trusteth; And he shall be brought to the king of terrors.
